manual_findings: Seeing all sixteen fragments together completely repaired the compositional loss: all 30 core fragments and all 30 conditional action or next-measurement fragments were selected.
The selector rejected all 396 frozen irrelevant fragments.

The selector also rejected all 24 same-case alternatives despite an explicit instruction to keep competing or mistaken views. It optimized for the best answer rather than preserving the evidence landscape.
Every best-supported cause or explicit uncertainty and every safe action or next measurement matched the frozen expected answer.
Because the alternative sources were gone, the synthesizer either omitted them or discussed them using the wrong citations. Three answers also added unsupported generic alternatives.
The result separates two jobs: bundle reasoning is strong for finding the best answer, while evidence preservation must be enforced mechanically or by a separate collection pass.
decision: Reject Gate 15D as the complete evidence-preserving harness, but accept its bundle view as a successful repair for X-to-Y composition and clear-junk removal. Do not ask one model decision to both optimize the best answer and preserve every relevant competing view.
next_test: Use two independent shelves before synthesis: a mechanical same-case shelf that preserves matching alternatives and lineages, and the Qwen3-8B best-answer shelf. The final writer receives both, labels support strength, and may not cite one shelf as evidence for the other.
